events.description: Ross Geller asks how Ross' grandmother is doing right now.
Aunt Lillian says that Aunt Phyllis says Ross' grandmother has only a matter of hours left.
Aunt Lillian states that Ross' grandmother's remaining time is only a matter of hours.
Monica Geller asks how Judy Geller is doing right now.
Judy Geller says Judy Geller is fine right now.
Judy Geller says Judy Geller is glad that Ross Geller and Monica Geller are here right now.
Judy Geller says Ross Geller and Monica Geller are here right now.
Judy Geller asks what is going on with Monica Geller's hair right now.
Judy Geller asks what is different about Monica Geller's hair right now.
Judy Geller says that the difference about Monica Geller's hair might be that nothing is different about it.
Monica Geller says Judy Geller is unbelievable right now.
Ross Geller tells Monica Geller to relax right now.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller and Monica Geller are going to be here for a while.
Ross Geller says the situation looks like Ross Geller and Monica Geller are going to be here for a while.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller and Monica Geller still have Monica Geller's boyfriends and Monica Geller's career to cover.
Ross Geller says the fuzzy little mints at the bottom of Ross' grandmother's purse were gross.

Ross Geller says Ross Geller loved Ross' grandmother's Sweet 'n' Low packets.
Ross Geller says Ross' grandmother used to steal Sweet 'n' Low packets from restaurants.
Ross Geller says Ross' grandmother looks so small right now.
Monica Geller says Monica Geller knows that Ross' grandmother looks so small right now.
Ross Geller says Ross' grandmother is with Pop-Pop and Aunt Phyllis now.
Judy Geller asks what is going on with the situation regarding Ross' grandmother's status right now.
Ross Geller asks Judy Geller if Judy Geller knows that Nurse Sizemore said Ross' grandmother had passed away earlier.
Ross Geller says Nurse Sizemore said that Ross' grandmother had passed away.
Ross Geller says Ross' grandmother is not actually dead right now.
Ross Geller says Ross' grandmother is not dead but is present and back now.
Ross Geller says Ross' grandmother may have died.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller and Monica Geller are looking into whether Ross' grandmother has died.
Ross Geller says Ross Geller will go and see Ross' grandmother.
Nurse Sizemore says that a situation like Ross' grandmother being pronounced dead and then showing signs of life almost never happens.
Ross Geller says Ross' grandmother has now passed away.
